attributes.title: Setting The Pace 2027
attributes.series: NYS ENA Setting the Pace Conference
attributes.organizer: New York State Council Emergency Nurses Association
attributes.summary:
The New York State Council of the Emergency Nurses Association holds Setting The Pace 2027, its annual emergency nursing conference, from April 21 to 23, 2027, at the Holiday Inn in Saratoga Springs, New York. The main conference day with the exhibit hall is Thursday, April 22, from 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

The council says more information will follow. Attendees book rooms directly with the Holiday Inn at 232 Broadway. Fees, the agenda and the number of contact hours were not posted when we checked.
